experiment: Run26: transfer fixed large-label workflow to a second real product

source_registration.source_preparation: original 3024x4032 photo reduced proportionally to 768x1024, no retouch or contrast adjustment
source_registration.scope: black handwritten tagline below main product name, not white-filled 비락식혜 wordmark
source_registration.annotation_method: new source-only coordinates chosen from source grid and print crop, no target image existed

generation_mode: built-in image_gen, one new ad with preplanned blank black handwritten tagline
data_role: second product; new generated scene; planned omission; not an accidental error or independent target-view real photo
delivery: normalize longest side to 1024 px, preserve aspect, no upscaling
fixed: Run23 SIFT, homography, confidence, blankness, ink extraction and native warp settings
source regions frozen before target generation
changed: new product, new source registration, new advertising scene
black handwritten tagline instead of black JamMate product-name line

gate.proceed: Automatically place the original black tagline, readable at final size, outside-support changes zero and no target manual correction; narrow second-product feasibility
gate.stop: If automatic alignment, blankness, placement or readability fails, stop without target-coordinate fixing or threshold tuning; define a narrower scope

timing: Measure source inspection/annotation/registration separately from product search, generation, code preparation and whole task. Agent annotation, not a human-user benchmark.
run_policy: Close this exploratory branch at Run26. Do not automatically schedule Run27. Success -> package a bounded prototype next; failure -> preserve JamMate/similar-label scope and close generalization claim.
